description: This file defines an abstract class 'AccessStrategy' within the OrangeHRM system, providing a base for access control strategies related to maintenance entities. It includes methods for managing parameters, entity class names, match criteria, and data retrieval, as well as formatting values and adding records to arrays.

classes.name: AccessStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for access control strategies in the OrangeHRM maintenance module.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Abstract method to determine access based on employee number.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MaintenanceService instance.

methods.name: getMatchByValues
methods.description: Generates match criteria array based on employee number.

methods.name: getEntityRecords
methods.description: Retrieves entity records using maintenance service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats a value using a specified formatting class.

methods.name: addRecordsToArray
methods.description: Adds entity data to an array based on parameters.
